title: A fuel log with corrections you can follow
description: A missed fill-up can be added while the order is preserved and the recalculation is explained.

blocks.text: A wrong date or a partial fill-up changes the consumption chart. Without flags, the numbers look more precise than the history they were gathered from.

quote.text: it keeps track of the gas mileage of my car, which allows me to know in detail whether my car mileage goes up or down. therefore giving me a really good idea of how my engine is working. Also this record helps the resale value of my car.

blocks.text: Support inserting a record, units of measurement and notes on the conditions of the trips. Before saving, show which stretches of the chart will be recalculated.
Do not call a deviation a diagnosis of the engine. First the completeness of the records and the comparability of conditions have to be checked.
